build.sources: gitCommit plus the changes of the commit that adds or rewrites this metadata, rendered from that working tree before committing

comparison: Compared by tests/smoke/test_golden_room.cpp with G01's tolerance (6/255 per channel, at most 0.5% of the pixels) on this GPU and driver only.
description: I5 step 3 golden of a console room's two screens (ADR-0016 §5): the snes-room fixture's room, the hero CRT on its cabinet playing the start choice's generated clip and the room's secondary TV (the classic pack's small CRT on a sideboard, in a sideboard's socket) playing Dappled Dovecote's clip (its playlist one game: video.json's per-screen keys), both held at 1.0 s (--video-freeze-pts), each on its decoder slot.

image.format: PNG, 8-bit RGB, sRGB-encoded as the window shows it

fixture.name: esde/snes-room
fixture.rule: SHA-256 of the lines "<relative path>\t<SHA-256 of the file>\n", sorted by path

run.regenerate: $env:RV_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1; build/msvc-x64-debug/bin/rv_smoke_tests.exe "golden/G19:*"; Remove-Item Env:RV_UPDATE_GOLDEN (then run it again without the variable; tests/smoke/test_golden_room.cpp)
steps: a first run of the same command but --frames 300 and without --video-freeze-pts, --spawn or --input-script: the plan generated and written, the covers into the cache

view: --spawn in front of the middle between the two screens, both in view (inside the room, at eye height, looking at that middle)
